result.title: Reliable Tree Recruitment from Scarce Annotations for Forest Inventory Expansion
authors: Heitor Eduardo Ferreira Campos Morato Filpi
result.summary: Species-level inventories of individual tree crowns (ITCs) from UAV imagery are limited by annotation cost: in tropical forests, many species are represented by only a handful of field-validated crowns. We propose a reliable tree recruitment framework that expands a small annotated inventory by iteratively self-training a multi-task DeepLabV3 network, combining semantic segmentation with a crown-distance regression head, on RGB UAV orthomosaics. At each iteration, candidate crowns enter the training inventory only if they pass a confidence filter on class probability and distance map and a morphology filter on crown area and solidity, with at most five new crowns per species, keeping recruited samples consistent with the reference inventory. We evaluate the framework at two Brazilian sites: an Amazonian rainforest in Acre (17 species, 355 annotated crowns, 4 cm GSD) and a forest site in the Cerrado of Maranhão (4 species, 51 annotated crowns, 1.8 cm GSD). Over 20 iterations, the number of retained crowns grew from about 500 to 960 in Acre and from about 700 to over 3100 in Maranhão, while crown-level F1 exceeded single- and multi-task DeepLabV3 baselines (53.5% vs. 50.0% and 45.2%; 92.2% vs. 79.7% and 83.6%). The framework offers a low-cost route to expanding species inventories with consumer-grade UAVs and limited fieldwork.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对 UAV 影像树种清单标注稀缺问题，提出迭代自训练的多任务 DeepLabV3 框架（语义分割＋冠幅距离回归），用类别概率与距离图置信过滤及面积、实心度形态过滤筛选新样本加入训练集，并在巴西两个站点评估扩充效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 「置信度＋形态」双门槛的伪标签准入与逐物种限量的扩充策略，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与监督数据可信度控制的借鉴线索，但该工作属遥感分割应用，与多模态推理状态本身无直接关系。
